newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes up 80 centavos at 1,079.8.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes up 80 centavos at 1,079.8.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 80 centavos to close at 1,079.8 against the dollar in stable trading, dealers said.

Dealers said banks were looking to build up dollar positions early in the session although two large banks moved to sell greenbacks around midday. There was also an influx of petrodollars and coffee earnings into the market.
Dealers reported 379 trades worth a total $186 million. The peso opened at 1,081.5, and crested at 1,079.5. The intraday low was 1,082.
